archetype: 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with a touch of 7 (Electric & Neon)
emotional_tone: Futuristic, cinematic, bold, minimalist, high-end tech

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-16 for main sections. Margins and paddings should feel open and cinematic.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento Grid protocol for products. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned typography for readability, centered for massive hero impact. Asymmetry in product layouts.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#040914]/60 border-b border-white/10.
surfaces.cards: Neumorphic/Glass hybrid: Flat background #0A101D, 1px subtle border, glowing hover state (Tracing Beam effect with #00E5FF).
surfaces.modals_cart: Solid background #040914 with strong border-white/10 to avoid refraction of data.

components.buttons: Sharp geometric edges or max rounded. Primary: bg-transparent border border-[#00E5FF] text-[#00E5FF] hover:bg-[#00E5FF] hover:text-[#040914] transition-all duration-300.
components.inputs: Shadcn based, customized with bg-[#0A101D] border-white/10 focus:border-[#00E5FF].
components.cart: Use a sliding sidebar (Sheet from Shadcn) with dark theme styling.
components.badges: Small, uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs, border border-[#3B82F6] text-[#3B82F6] bg-blue-900/20

animations.hero: Scroll-triggered parallax, slow opacity fades, and scale-in for images.
animations.interactions: Hover state lifts (-translate-y-1) and adds box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,229,255,0.2).
animations.scrolling: Smooth momentum scrolling (Lenis if possible, otherwise CSS smooth scroll).

hero_background.description: Abstract blue geometric pattern for the cinematic hero background overlay

pages.home: Cinematic Hero Landing. Full viewport height. Massive H1 (text-5xl to text-7xl fluid) in Outfit. Parallax scrolling to Products section.
pages.products: Grid layout. Cinematic cards showcasing the Fidget Cone ($5), Infinity Cube ($4), and Party Hats. Hover effects on cards.
pages.order_cart: Stripe/PayPal checkout flow elements. Clear hierarchy, high contrast text for pricing and totals.
pages.about: Rich text and imagery of the studio. Organic flow.
pages.contact: Minimalist contact form. Input fields with bottom borders only, or subtle full borders.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against dark backgrounds meets APCA standards. Use #F8FAFC for body.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React + Tailwind + Shadcn UI setup.
Apply Outfit for all headers, IBM Plex Sans for body.
Do NOT use Inter or standard fonts for headings.
Use Framer Motion for scroll animations in the Hero section.
Build an E-Commerce cart flow (can mock actual Stripe/PayPal if API keys not provided, but UI must reflect it).
Never use placeholder images, strictly use the media URLs provided.
